source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: They must not repeat the content; they also need to be unique.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The translated version is here. Please handle two things: verify every interactive field, then ensure each one has a label matching the fourth step (see control-label-sample.png).

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: To preserve the purpose of each field, its label needs to match the text initially shown inside it. After users delete that text and enter something else, hovering should let them recover the field’s original intention if they forget it.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The label and the field should both display it—both places.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Even after the field is emptied, the help text should remain available.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Because an empty field would not be visible to the user, do not leave the field without visible in-field text. It’s acceptable for the help text to appear twice, in the label and in the field.
